scope: Minimum authority contracts for unresolved BLOCKED, OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED, and PARTIAL findings.
globalStopConditions: Any command would print a secret, token, seed phrase, private key, wallet password, recovery phrase, encrypted vault value, or production data payload.
A wallet confirmation, signing prompt, transaction prompt, token approval, transfer, mint, bridge, or spending allowance request appears.
A command would deploy, mutate infrastructure, rotate secrets, or mutate production data outside an explicitly approved contract.
The observed target repository, Supabase project, or Cloudflare service does not match the repository-documented target.
The requested authority is broader than the contract states.

contracts.exactPurpose: Verify authenticated read access to public.profile_reputation_summaries against the target Supabase project using a short-lived non-privileged authenticated JWT.
contracts.rollbackPlan: Remove the process environment variable after the command; no repository or production data changes are expected.
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Redacted JSON showing anon and authenticated checks pass; no bearer token value printed.
stopConditions: The token is not short-lived or is privileged beyond authenticated read access.
The command attempts Auth user creation or service-role fallback.
Output includes a bearer token or secret value.
revocationConditions: Immediately revoke or expire the supplied JWT after verification.
Do not persist the JWT in repository files.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Owner runs the exact command locally and provides redacted JSON output, avoiding Codex secret access.

contracts.exactPurpose: Record and implement the owner-selected supplier media policy: approve, proxy, block, or sanitize supplier image origins.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "s\.alicdn|alicdn|Alibaba|imageUrl|img-src|Content-Security-Policy" src supabase scripts docs README.md SECURITY.md index.html
filesOrServicesTouched: optional CSP/deployment documentation if owner selects CSP policy
contracts.rollbackPlan: Revert only the local policy/docs/test changes for this origin if smoke or security scan regresses.
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Smoke either passes with documented approved origin or fails with the owner-selected block/proxy behavior documented.
stopConditions: Owner has not selected approve, proxy, block, or sanitize.
A change would remove marketplace media behavior without owner approval.
A change would add a new production external origin beyond the selected policy.
revocationConditions: Owner withdraws supplier media approval.
The CDN origin is observed serving non-image active content in a context not governed by policy.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Owner supplies a written origin policy; Codex updates local docs/tests only.

contracts.exactPurpose: Add dev-only TypeScript checking with a staged, non-strict baseline and no production dependency additions.
filesOrServicesTouched: optional src/vite-env.d.ts or equivalent ambient type declarations
contracts.rollbackPlan: npm uninstall --save-dev typescript @types/react @types/react-dom @types/node; remove tsconfig.check.json and any ambient type file added for this contract.
contracts.maximumExecutionDuration: 90 minutes for first baseline run; stop sooner if error volume is too high.
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Typecheck command exists, verify:repo-tooling reports typecheck available, and an initial tsc result is recorded without suppressing warnings.
stopConditions: npm attempts to add production dependencies.
Initial typecheck error volume requires unrelated refactors.
A config would change runtime build behavior instead of adding noEmit validation.
revocationConditions: Owner rejects adding TypeScript dev tooling.
The dependency install source cannot be verified as npm/local CI-safe cache.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Owner installs the dev tooling in a branch and provides the resulting lockfile and typecheck output for review.

contracts.exactPurpose: Select a repository lint stack and baseline before any dependency/config change.
filesOrServicesTouched: future linter config after owner selection
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Owner-selected lint tool and rule baseline, or explicit decision to defer.
stopConditions: Owner has not selected ESLint, Biome, Oxlint, or another specific tool.
A proposed linter would require production dependencies.
revocationConditions: Owner defers lint stack selection.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Keep existing structural verifier and security scans until a lint stack is selected.

contracts.exactPurpose: Verify branch protection, required checks, and Actions secret-name presence without reading secret values.
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Required-check names, branch protection settings, and secret names only; no secret values.
stopConditions: GitHub token has write/admin mutation scopes beyond read metadata.
Command output includes secret values.
Repository target differs from origin.
revocationConditions: Revoke the read token after verification if a temporary token is used.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Owner runs the commands and provides redacted output.

contracts.finding: Signed releases and release provenance owner decision
contracts.exactPurpose: Capture owner decision for release signing identity, provenance format, custody, and enforcement before any signing authority exists in the workspace.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "cosign|sigstore|slsa|provenance|attestation|signed release|gpg|signing" README.md SECURITY.md docs .github scripts package.json
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Owner decision document naming signing approach and whether implementation is deferred.
stopConditions: A signing key or token would be given to Codex.
A command would create signed artifacts without owner-controlled signing infrastructure.
revocationConditions: Owner changes signing model or custody requirements.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Keep deterministic build and SBOM evidence while owner designs signing outside this workspace.

contracts.exactPurpose: Document owner-approved dependency range, lockfile, override, audit, and update lifecycle policy.
contracts.rollbackPlan: Revert only the dependency-policy documentation changes if owner does not approve the text.
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Documentation states direct range policy, lockfile policy, override lifecycle, and audit cadence without changing runtime dependencies.
stopConditions: Policy owner is not identified.
A dependency update would be required to document the policy.
revocationConditions: Owner changes dependency governance policy.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Owner supplies the policy text; Codex only places it in repository docs.

contracts.exactPurpose: Decide fuzzing scope, CI budget, and tool allowance before adding any fuzzing dependency.
filesOrServicesTouched: future tests under src or scripts after owner scope decision
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Owner-approved fuzzing scope or explicit deferral.
stopConditions: Fuzzing would require new dev dependencies without owner approval.
Fuzzing target would hit external services or wallets.
revocationConditions: Owner defers fuzzing program.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Add only deterministic table-driven edge tests after owner approves specific surfaces.

contracts.exactPurpose: Identify owner-approved contract source/model and symbolic execution target before adding any tooling.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "symbolic|echidna|hevm|mythril|manticore|foundry|forge" README.md SECURITY.md docs scripts supabase src package.json
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Owner identifies source/model and accepted symbolic execution tool, or defers.
stopConditions: Contract source ownership is not established.
Tool would be installed before target invariants are defined.
revocationConditions: Owner defers symbolic execution.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Keep ABI/signature snapshot as reference until owned source/model is supplied.

contracts.exactPurpose: Add only deterministic invariant tests using existing Vitest/Node tooling for owner-approved surfaces.
contracts.rollbackPlan: Revert only the added invariant tests/script checks if they prove too broad or flaky.
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Additional deterministic invariant tests pass without new dependency.
stopConditions: A generated property-testing dependency is required.
The invariant requires external service calls or wallet interaction.
revocationConditions: Owner rejects the proposed invariant scope.

contracts.finding: Formal invariant proof feasibility owner decision
contracts.exactPurpose: Define formal proof scope, accepted modeling language, and acceptance criteria before adding any proof tooling.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "formal|invariant proof|tla|alloy|coq|lean|isabelle|model check|temporal" README.md SECURITY.md docs scripts src package.json
filesOrServicesTouched: future formal model files after owner approval
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Owner-approved formal proof scope or explicit deferral.
stopConditions: A proof tool would be installed before the model and invariant scope are defined.
A proof claim would be documented without machine-checkable artifact.
revocationConditions: Owner defers formal proof.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Continue using deterministic tests and runtime spec documentation.

contracts.exactPurpose: Document owner-provided incident reporting, triage, escalation, severity, and post-incident process.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "incident|vulnerability|report|escalation|severity|post-incident" README.md SECURITY.md docs supabase scripts
contracts.rollbackPlan: Revert only the incident-response documentation changes if owner does not approve them.
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Repository incident response process with no invented SLA or personnel claims.
stopConditions: Owner has not supplied maintainer channel, escalation path, or severity policy.
Text would imply compliance, SLA, or staffing not evidenced by owner.
revocationConditions: Owner changes the incident response process.

contracts.exactPurpose: Document owner-approved rotation order, validation, rollback, and secret ownership without rotating any secret.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "rotate|rotation|key|secret|credential" README.md SECURITY.md docs scripts supabase
contracts.rollbackPlan: Revert only the key-rotation documentation changes if owner does not approve them.
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Runbook names secret classes and rotation sequence without secret values.
stopConditions: Any secret value is needed or would be printed.
The procedure would rotate or invalidate live secrets.
revocationConditions: Owner changes secret ownership or rotation order.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Owner supplies a redacted rotation matrix; Codex documents it.

contracts.exactPurpose: Review owner-provided redacted DR drill evidence or produce a non-production drill checklist without running a restore.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "disaster|recovery|restore|rollback|drill|backup" README.md SECURITY.md docs supabase scripts
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Owner-provided dated drill evidence or explicit decision to create a non-production drill plan.
stopConditions: Evidence includes production data, credentials, or backup contents.
A restore would target production.
revocationConditions: Owner defers DR drill documentation.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Use redacted owner-run restore output from a non-production environment.

contracts.exactPurpose: Review owner-provided rollback procedure and deployment history without performing a rollback.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "rollback|revert|emergency|deploy|migration drift" README.md SECURITY.md docs supabase scripts
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Owner-approved rollback policy or redacted rollback evidence.
stopConditions: Any command would trigger a deploy, rollback, or infrastructure mutation.
Evidence includes secret values.
revocationConditions: Owner changes deploy/rollback ownership.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Owner exports Cloudflare/Supabase deployment history screenshots or text with secrets redacted.

contracts.exactPurpose: Capture owner-provided RPO/RTO, backup validation, and restore evidence without accessing backups.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "recovery|repair|restore|backfill|projection" README.md SECURITY.md docs supabase scripts package.json
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Owner-provided recovery objectives and restore evidence, redacted.
stopConditions: Backup contents or production data would be exposed.
A restore command would be required.
revocationConditions: Owner changes recovery objectives.

contracts.exactPurpose: Verify redacted environment separation metadata without reading secret values or mutating deployments.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "environment|production|local|staging|VITE_|secret|Cloudflare" README.md SECURITY.md docs supabase .github package.json wrangler.jsonc
filesOrServicesTouched: owner-provided Cloudflare Worker build variable names
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Environment names, project refs, and secret names only; no values.
stopConditions: A command would reveal secret values.
A token has write/deploy permissions.
revocationConditions: Revoke temporary read token after verification.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Owner provides redacted exports of environment names and variable names.

contracts.exactPurpose: Define attestation format, storage path, required fields, and enforcement before live deployment metadata access.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "attestation|provenance|staging|production|environment|deploy|cloudflare|supabase" README.md SECURITY.md docs .github wrangler.jsonc supabase package.json
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Owner-approved attestation schema or explicit deferral.
stopConditions: A command would deploy or mutate Cloudflare/Supabase.
Attestation claims would be made without source metadata.
revocationConditions: Owner changes deployment attestation policy.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Start with an owner-supplied static attestation manifest template.

contracts.exactPurpose: Verify whether production Edge configuration enables broad preview origins, without changing Edge variables.
exactCommandsToBeExecuted: rg -n "ORINA_CORS_ALLOW_PREVIEW_ORIGINS|ORINA_CORS_ENV|vercel\.app|netlify\.app|workers\.dev|supabase\.co" supabase docs scripts README.md SECURITY.md
filesOrServicesTouched: owner-provided redacted Supabase Edge Function env variable names
contracts.expectedEvidenceOutput: Redacted evidence showing whether ORINA_CORS_ALLOW_PREVIEW_ORIGINS is set in production.
stopConditions: A command would set or change Edge Function environment variables.
Secret values are exposed.
revocationConditions: Owner changes preview-origin policy.
contracts.leastPrivilegeAlternative: Owner provides a redacted environment export showing variable names and boolean presence only.
